response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name) SELECT Name, avg_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms / (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM per) AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM per WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM per) IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The 'plain average across all the media types' is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type averages of Bytes/Milliseconds (one value per media type name), not the average over all individual tracks.
Bytes/Milliseconds uses real (non-integer) division, and a track with Milliseconds = 0 gives a missing ratio that the average ignores.
Groups are by media type name.

alternatives.interpretation: The across-media-type average is taken over all qualifying tracks (track-weighted), not over the per-type averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, t.UnitPrice AS UnitPrice, 1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0) AS r FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804), per AS (SELECT Name, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(r) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM base GROUP BY Name) SELECT Name, avg_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms / (SELECT AVG(r) FROM base) AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM per WHERE (SELECT AVG(r) FROM base) IS NOT NULL
